question: With reference to the Green Revolution in India, what does ‘H’ stand for in ‘HYV’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**High**__.

__
 
• With reference to the **Green Revolution in India **‘H in ‘HYV’ stands for high.
 
• **The Green Revolution** involved the production of** high-yielding varieties** (often abbreviated as **HYV**) of seeds, resulting in an increase in agricultural production to combat food shortage and increase the revenue of the agricultural sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **About Green Revolution**

 
 
• **M.S. Swaminathan **is considered the** father of the green revolution.**
 
• In the year **1965**, the government of India launched the **Green Revolution** with the help of** M.S. Swaminathan** who was a geneticist. 
 
• He developed **new ideas** and creativity in **agricultural products**. 
 
• His idea of the development of agriculture furnished a lot.
 
• Hence he is regarded as the father of the green revolution. 
 
• **M.S. Swaminathan termed **a few aspects for the easy flow of this revolution. 
 
• He developed a** few methods** and **aspects** for the production of goods and raw materials. 
 
• The main aim and aspects of the** green revolution** included the following
 
 
• **​High Yielding Varieties (HYV)**
 
• **Mechanization of Agriculture**
 
• **Use of Chemical Fertilizers and Pesticides**
 
• **Irrigation**
